voiceReason: Only Ryan and Aiden are English-native stock voices, both male. Bubbly is Vivian (a bright young female voice), laconic is Aiden (a clear mid-range male) and late-night is Uncle_Fu (a low, mellow male). Vivian and Uncle_Fu are Chinese-native timbres speaking English, which is the closest the stock set gets to the three registers.
notes: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice at revision 0c0e3051, run through the qwen-tts 0.1.1 package (generate_custom_voice, language English, fixed seed). It has no inline cue tags. Free-text instruct control exists but the shim does not use it. Weights are about 4.3 GB on disk and download at first start. One CPU line took 77 s warm on a quiet box (16 cores, nothing else rendering, 2026-10-23), so the CPU tier is dropped.
